newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL MAKE CHALLENGING 240-6 AGAINST KENYA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL MAKE CHALLENGING 240-6 AGAINST KENYA.

text.p: A well-paced fourth-wicket stand
of 145 between opener Doug Watson and Derek Crookes propelled
Natal to a challenging 240 for six in their Standard Bank Cup
quarter-final match against Kenya at Kingsmead on Wednesday.
Watson (85) and Crookes (72) came together with Natal in
some trouble at 33 for three in the 12th over after tight
new-ball bowling from Martin Suji and all-rounder Thomas Odoyo.
But, with growing confidence and nimble running between the
wickets, the pair added 145 runs for the fourth-wicket in only
28 overs to establish a sound platform to the Natal innings.
The partnership between Watson and Crookes set a new Natal
record for the fourth-wicket in the domestic limited-overs
competition, beating the previous mark of 129 between Daryll
Bestall and Mike Procter against Northern Transvaal during the
Although Kenyan slow-left armer Asif Karim bowled with great
control for figures of 0-35 in his nine overs, Natal were able
to post a challenging total with captain Dale Benkenstein (22
not out) and Mark Bruyns (18 not out) closing the innings with a
risk stand of 39 in only three overs.
